newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks open firm on buoyant Dow.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks open firm on buoyant Dow.

text.p: Australian shares opened firmer on light volume after Wall Street's post-election strength continued on Thursday.
At 10.20 a.m. (2320 GMT), the All Ordinaries index was 9.4 points firmer at 2,356.1.
The December share price index was up 13 points at 2,371 and at a 14.9 point premium to the underlying index.
The market was firmer across the board with the resource sector doing slightly better than the industrial sector as metal stocks rebounded from selling on Thursday.
"The SPI was up in Sycom trading last night giving a big buy hint this morning," a dealer from a Melbourne-based brokerage said.
The dealer said local investors were timid buyers after Thursday's disappointing session.
However, there was a reasonable amount of buying support for major resource issues after base metal prices edged higher on the London Metal Exchange.
"Copper finished above US$2,000 last night and this has helped give the market the confidence to get back into resources today," the dealer said.
Transport group Brambles Industries was one of the stronger industrial issues ahead of its annual meeting this afternoon.
